failures.evidence: An exact-version source never installs. `runtime.kubernetes.plugins: {pi_legion: 9.6.1, pi_envoy: 9.5.1}` is accepted by the loader (`legion start --check-config` → `plugins: @sjawhar/pi-legion 9.6.1 @sjawhar/pi-envoy 9.5.1 (from legion.yaml)`, exit 0), and a binary built with `-X main.piLegionVersion=9.6.1 -X main.piEnvoyVersion=9.5.1` — the shape release.yaml links (`$PI_LEGION_VERSION` is the bare published version) — prints the same pair `(from the binary)`; ResolvedPlugins hands both to specs.SpawnSpec unchanged, and installScript (internal/runtime/sandbox/plugins.go) renders `/usr/local/bin/bun add --exact '9.6.1' '9.5.1'`. Run in this pod with a stand-in agent, bun answers `error: Package "9.6.1" with tag "latest" not found, but package exists` / `error: 9.6.1@ failed to resolve` (and the same for 9.5.1), the wrapper prints `legion plugins: installing 9.6.1 and 9.5.1 failed` and exits 1 before `exec` — no `AGENT STARTED`. A bare version is a package name to `bun add`; only `@sjawhar/pi-legion@9.6.1` names the package at a version. Tarball paths and http(s) URLs (what the implementer's proof and stage 4a's checkpoint use) work, so neither caught it. Consequence under production's default source, the release-linked pair: at the first boot every live claim is relaunched, every install fails before Oh My Pi starts, the launcher reports the child gone, each death is charged, and the launch budget ends every live role in `worker-died` — the fleet-wide stall this change exists to prevent. Both run the rendered script under sh with a stand-in bun at the script's own bun path and read the words bun receives. After the fix, docs/kubernetes.md's `bun add --exact <pi-legion source> <pi-envoy source>` sentence (Contract discipline) and the stage 4a checkpoint, which installs tarballs only, should say/exercise the version form too (pi-envoy 9.5.1 by version would do until a pi-legion at contract 24 is published).
